entries.reason: Bundled inside next@16.2.12's own vendored dependency tree (node_modules/next/node_modules/postcss) -- not a dependency this project depends on directly, and no Next.js release currently resolves it. `npm audit fix --force` recommends downgrading to next@9.3.3, a 7-major-version regression that removes the App Router entirely -- an unacceptable trade for a moderate-severity XSS in a code path (CSS stringification) this project's build does not exercise with untrusted input.

Same root cause as GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93 -- bundled inside next@16.2.12, no non-breaking fix available. Arbitrary file read via a crafted sourceMappingURL in a CSS comment; this project does not process untrusted CSS input at build or runtime.
Same root cause as GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93 -- bundled inside next@16.2.12, no non-breaking fix available. Path traversal via sourceMappingURL auto-loading; same reasoning as above.

sharp is bundled by next@16.2.12 for its built-in image optimisation (next/image) -- this project does not use next/image yet (Phase 8: Frontend Dashboard). Inherited libvips CVEs (CVE-2026-33327/33328/35590/35591) have no fix available without downgrading Next.js 7 major versions.
